harness

questions.prompt: Patients who stop taking antibiotics before completing the prescribed course may suffer a ---- of the infection, often in a form that is harder to treat.

consensus
recurrence
vaccination

questions.prompt: The treaty was signed in 1648, but its provisions were implemented only ----, as many regional rulers resisted the loss of their traditional privileges.

entirely
gradually
uniformly

questions.prompt: Geologists have begun to ---- the unusual rock formations to see whether they were created by volcanic activity or by the slow movement of glaciers.

questions.prompt: Although the disease is rarely fatal, it is highly ----, spreading quickly among people who live or work in close proximity to one another.

questions.prompt: Developing countries often struggle to ---- sustainable economic growth because of high levels of debt, political instability and limited access to foreign investment.
options: attain
postpone
distort
abandon
undermine
questions.explanation_tr: attain = ulaşmak, elde etmek. Borç ve istikrarsızlık gibi engeller, sürdürülebilir büyümeye ulaşmayı zorlaştırır.

questions.prompt: The ---- of the bridge's steel cables, caused by decades of exposure to moisture, eventually forced the authorities to close it to heavy traffic.
options: elasticity
installation
corrosion
reinforcement
durability
questions.explanation_tr: corrosion = paslanma, aşınma. Nemin yol açtığı ve köprünün kapatılmasına neden olan şey çelik kabloların paslanmasıdır.

questions.prompt: Many common medications, such as painkillers, are ---- available without a prescription, which raises concerns about their misuse by the general public.

rarely
scarcely
readily

questions.explanation_tr: readily = kolayca. İlaçların reçetesiz kolayca bulunabilmesi kötüye kullanım endişesi doğurur.

questions.prompt: After the stock market crash of 1929, many investors were forced to ---- their plans for expansion, as banks refused to lend money to new businesses.

catch up with
stand for
look after

questions.explanation_tr: give up = vazgeçmek. Bankalar kredi vermeyince yatırımcılar büyüme planlarından vazgeçmek zorunda kaldı.

questions.prompt: Fossil fuels are considered a ---- resource, since they take millions of years to form and are being consumed much faster than they can be replaced.
options: flexible
renewable
finite
sustainable
abundant
questions.explanation_tr: finite = sınırlı, tükenebilir. Yerine konduklarından çok daha hızlı tüketilmeleri fosil yakıtların sınırlı olduğunu gösterir.

questions.prompt: Scientists hope that gene therapy will one day ---- inherited disorders such as cystic fibrosis by replacing the faulty gene responsible for the condition.
options: trigger
cure
inherit
mimic
transmit
questions.explanation_tr: cure = tedavi etmek, iyileştirmek. Hatalı geni değiştirmek hastalığı tedavi etmeye yöneliktir.

questions.prompt: In many ancient societies, the ---- of wealth was highly unequal, with a small elite controlling most of the land and resources while the majority lived in poverty.

imitation

abundance
questions.explanation_tr: distribution = dağılım. Küçük bir seçkin grubun kaynakların çoğunu kontrol etmesi, servetin eşitsiz dağıldığını anlatır.

questions.prompt: The two experiments were conducted ----, so that the results could be compared under exactly the same temperature and pressure conditions.
options: randomly
carelessly
incorrectly

occasionally
questions.explanation_tr: simultaneously = eş zamanlı olarak. Deneylerin tam olarak aynı koşullarda karşılaştırılabilmesi için aynı anda yapılması gerekir.

questions.prompt: Doctors were unable to ---- the cause of the patient's chronic headaches until advanced imaging revealed a small tumour near the optic nerve.

questions.explanation_tr: figure out = anlamak, çözmek. Doktorlar baş ağrısının nedenini ancak görüntüleme sonrasında anlayabildi.

questions.prompt: The archaeologists' findings were ---- with earlier theories, thus providing further support for the view that the city was abandoned because of a prolonged drought.

obsessed
inconsistent
consistent

questions.explanation_tr: consistent with = ile tutarlı, uyumlu. 'providing further support' ifadesi bulguların önceki teorileri desteklediğini gösterir.

questions.prompt: Engineers have developed sensors that can ---- even the slightest vibrations in a building's structure, allowing potential damage to be identified before it becomes dangerous.
options: absorb
amplify
ignore
detect
produce
questions.explanation_tr: detect = algılamak, tespit etmek. Hasarın önceden belirlenebilmesi için sensörlerin titreşimleri algılaması gerekir.

questions.prompt: A balanced diet rich in fruit and vegetables helps to strengthen the body's ---- to infections, reducing the likelihood of frequent illness.
options: vulnerability
tendency
resistance
susceptibility
exposure
questions.explanation_tr: resistance = direnç. Sık hastalanma olasılığını azaltan şey vücudun enfeksiyonlara karşı direncinin güçlenmesidir.

questions.prompt: The government decided to ---- the proposal to raise taxes on small businesses, fearing that it would provoke widespread public opposition.

questions.prompt: Since the first artificial satellite ---- into orbit in 1957, thousands of man-made objects ---- the Earth, creating a growing problem of space debris.

questions.explanation_tr: 'Since' ile başlayan yan cümlede geçmişteki belirli zaman (in 1957) için simple past, ana cümlede ise geçmişten bugüne süren durum için present perfect kullanılır.

questions.prompt: In 1990, only a small fraction of households in the region ---- access to the internet, but today almost every home ---- a broadband connection.

questions.prompt: Climate models predict that by 2050, sea levels ---- by up to thirty centimetres unless global emissions ---- significantly in the coming decades.

questions.explanation_tr: 'by 2050' gelecekte bir noktaya kadar tamamlanacak olayı gösterdiği için future perfect (will have risen) kullanılır; 'unless' yan cümlesinde gelecek anlamı simple present ile verilir, emisyonlar azaltıldığı için edilgen (are reduced) olur.

By absorbing about a quarter of the carbon dioxide released by human activities, the oceans intensify the effects of climate change; however, this process is making seawater increasingly acidic.
Because seawater is becoming increasingly acidic, the oceans can no longer absorb the carbon dioxide released by human activities or mitigate climate change.
By absorbing about a quarter of the carbon dioxide released by human activities, the oceans mitigate the effects of climate change; however, this process is making seawater increasingly acidic.
By absorbing about a quarter of the carbon dioxide released by human activities, the oceans mitigate the effects of climate change, and this process has no effect on the acidity of seawater.
questions.explanation_tr: 'Dörtte bir' (a quarter), 'hafifletmek' (mitigate) ve asitleşme D'de doğru; A oranı 'three quarters', B 'intensify' ile etkiyi, E asitleşmeyi olumsuzluyor.

questions.prompt: Kalp krizi geçiren hastaların ilk bir saat içinde tedavi edilmesi, kalp kasında oluşabilecek kalıcı hasarı büyük ölçüde azaltır ve hastaların hayatta kalma şansını artırır.
options: Treating patients who have had a heart attack within the first day greatly reduces the permanent damage that may occur in the heart muscle and increases their chance of survival.
Treating patients who have had a heart attack within the first hour slightly reduces the permanent damage to the heart muscle but does not affect their chance of survival.
Treating patients who have had a heart attack within the first hour greatly reduces the permanent damage that may occur in the heart muscle and increases their chance of survival.
Patients who have had a heart attack are certain to suffer permanent damage to the heart muscle unless they are treated within the first week.
Permanent damage to the heart muscle increases the risk of a heart attack, so patients should be treated within the first hour.
questions.explanation_tr: 'İlk bir saat', 'büyük ölçüde azaltır' ve 'hayatta kalma şansını artırır' yalnızca C'de bulunuyor; A 'first day', B 'slightly' ve olumsuzluk, E ters neden-sonuç içeriyor.

questions.prompt: Arkeologlar, Anadolu'da yeni keşfedilen yerleşim yerinin tarımın bölgede daha önce düşünülenden en az bin yıl önce başladığını gösterebileceğine inanmakla birlikte, kesin sonuç için daha fazla kazı yapılması gerektiğini vurgulamaktadır.
options: Archaeologists claim that the newly discovered settlement in Anatolia proves that agriculture began in the region at least a thousand years earlier than previously thought, so no further excavation is needed.

Although archaeologists believe that the newly discovered settlement in Anatolia may show that agriculture began in the region at least a thousand years later than previously thought, they emphasise that more excavation is needed.

Although archaeologists believe that the newly discovered settlement in Anatolia may show that agriculture began in the region at most a hundred years earlier than previously thought, they emphasise that more excavation is needed.
Archaeologists believe that further excavation in Anatolia may lead to the discovery of a settlement showing that agriculture began in the region earlier than previously thought.

Although archaeologists believe that the newly discovered settlement in Anatolia may show that agriculture began in the region at least a thousand years earlier than previously thought, they emphasise that more excavation is needed for a definite conclusion.
questions.explanation_tr: 'En az bin yıl önce', 'gösterebileceğine' (may show) ve daha fazla kazı gerekliliği E'de eksiksiz verilmiş; A kesinlik bildiriyor, B 'later', C 'at most a hundred' diyor, D ise yerleşimin zaten keşfedildiğini göz ardı ediyor.

questions.prompt: Bitkiler kuraklık stresine maruz kaldığında su kaybını azaltmak için yapraklarındaki gözenekleri kapatır; ancak bu durum fotosentez hızının da düşmesine yol açar.
options: When plants are exposed to drought stress, they close the pores on their leaves to reduce water loss, but this also causes the rate of photosynthesis to fall.
When plants are exposed to drought stress, they open the pores on their leaves to increase water loss, but this also causes the rate of photosynthesis to fall.
When plants are exposed to drought stress, they close the pores on their leaves to reduce water loss, which in turn increases the rate of photosynthesis.
Because the rate of photosynthesis falls, plants close the pores on their leaves even when they are not exposed to drought stress.
When plants are exposed to drought stress, they close the pores on their roots to reduce water loss, but this also causes the rate of photosynthesis to fall.
questions.explanation_tr: Yapraklardaki gözeneklerin kapanması ve fotosentez hızının düşmesi yalnızca A'da doğru; C hızın arttığını, E 'roots' diyerek yeri, D neden-sonucu değiştiriyor.

questions.prompt: Dünya Sağlık Örgütü'ne göre gelişmekte olan ülkelerde temiz suya ve temel sanitasyon hizmetlerine erişimin artırılması, beş yaş altı çocuk ölümlerinin önemli bir kısmını önleyebilir.
options: According to the World Health Organization, improving access to clean water and basic sanitation services in developing countries could prevent all deaths among children under five.

According to the World Health Organization, improving access to clean water and basic sanitation services in developing countries could prevent a significant proportion of deaths among children under five.

According to the World Health Organization, improving access to clean water and basic sanitation services in developed countries could prevent a significant proportion of deaths among children under five.

According to the World Health Organization, improved access to clean water and basic sanitation services in developing countries has already prevented a small proportion of deaths among children under five.
According to the World Health Organization, reducing the deaths of children under five in developing countries could improve access to clean water and basic sanitation services.
questions.explanation_tr: 'Önemli bir kısmını önleyebilir' B'de 'could prevent a significant proportion' olarak karşılanmış; A 'all', C 'developed', D zaman ve miktar, E neden-sonuç hatası içeriyor.

questions.prompt: Although wind and solar power have become considerably cheaper over the past decade, their output fluctuates with the weather, which means that reliable storage systems are still essential.
options: Because wind and solar power have become much cheaper in the last decade, reliable storage systems are no longer needed despite weather-related fluctuations.
Wind and solar power will become considerably cheaper over the next decade if reliable storage systems can prevent their output from fluctuating with the weather.
The output of wind and solar power fluctuates with the weather because reliable storage systems have become considerably cheaper over the past decade.
Even though the cost of wind and solar power has fallen considerably in the last ten years, reliable storage systems remain necessary because their output varies with the weather.
Reliable storage systems have become considerably cheaper over the past ten years, so wind and solar power are no longer affected by the weather.
questions.explanation_tr: Ucuzlamaya rağmen ('although') hava koşullarına bağlı dalgalanma yüzünden depolamanın hâlâ gerekli olduğu yalnızca D'de korunmuş; A 'no longer needed' diyerek sonucu tersine çeviriyor.

questions.prompt: Doctors are increasingly reluctant to prescribe strong painkillers for long-term use, as growing evidence suggests that these drugs can lead to dependence without providing lasting relief.
options: Since there is mounting evidence that strong painkillers may cause dependence while failing to offer long-lasting relief, doctors are becoming more hesitant to prescribe them for extended periods.
Doctors are increasingly willing to prescribe strong painkillers for long-term use because new evidence shows that they provide lasting relief without causing dependence.
Growing evidence suggests that strong painkillers provide lasting relief, but doctors are reluctant to prescribe them because they always cause dependence.
Doctors have always refused to prescribe strong painkillers, even though there is no evidence that these drugs lead to dependence.
As doctors are reluctant to prescribe strong painkillers for long-term use, patients increasingly become dependent on other drugs that provide lasting relief.
questions.explanation_tr: 'Reluctant' = 'hesitant', 'growing evidence' = 'mounting evidence', 'without providing lasting relief' = 'failing to offer long-lasting relief'; A tüm unsurları korur. C 'lasting relief' sağladığını ve 'always' ile kesinlik bildiriyor.

questions.prompt: It was not until the late nineteenth century that compulsory primary education was introduced in most European countries, largely in response to the demands of an industrialising economy.
options: Compulsory primary education was introduced in most European countries well before the nineteenth century, partly to meet the needs of industry.
In the late nineteenth century, a few European countries abolished compulsory primary education because the industrialising economy no longer demanded it.
Most European countries made primary education compulsory only in the late nineteenth century, mainly because an industrialising economy required it.
The industrialising economy of the late nineteenth century emerged largely as a result of compulsory primary education in most European countries.
Although the industrialising economy demanded it, most European countries did not introduce compulsory primary education until well into the twentieth century.
questions.explanation_tr: 'It was not until ... that' yapısı 'only in the late nineteenth century' ile, 'largely in response to' ise 'mainly because' ile C'de karşılanmış; D neden-sonucu tersine çeviriyor, E dönemi değiştiriyor.

questions.prompt: Had early astronomers been able to measure stellar distances accurately, they would have realised much sooner that the universe is far larger than the Milky Way.
options: Because early astronomers measured stellar distances accurately, they soon realised that the universe is far larger than the Milky Way.
Early astronomers quickly realised that the universe is larger than the Milky Way even though they were unable to measure stellar distances.
If early astronomers can measure stellar distances accurately, they will realise that the Milky Way is far larger than the universe.
Early astronomers were able to measure stellar distances accurately, but they still failed to realise that the universe is larger than the Milky Way.
Early astronomers would have understood much earlier that the universe extends well beyond the Milky Way if they had been capable of measuring the distances to stars precisely.
questions.explanation_tr: Devrik 'Had ... been able' yapısı geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş bir koşul bildirir; bunu yalnızca E ('would have ... if they had been') korur. A ve D ölçümün yapıldığını söyleyerek gerçek olmayan koşulu gerçeğe çeviriyor.

questions.prompt: Unlike earlier studies, which relied on small samples, the new trial involved over ten thousand participants, making its conclusions about the drug's safety far more reliable.
options: Like earlier studies, the new trial relied on a small sample, so its conclusions about the drug's safety are not very reliable.
Because it included more than ten thousand participants, the new trial reached far more trustworthy conclusions about the drug's safety than earlier studies based on small samples.
The new trial involved fewer than ten thousand participants, which is why its conclusions about the drug's safety are less reliable than those of earlier studies.
Earlier studies with small samples had already shown that the drug was safe, so the new trial with ten thousand participants was unnecessary.
Although the new trial involved more than ten thousand participants, its conclusions about the drug's safety are no more reliable than those of earlier studies.
questions.explanation_tr: Büyük örneklem nedeniyle sonuçların çok daha güvenilir olduğu ('making ... far more reliable') B'de 'because' ile korunmuş; E aynı veriye rağmen güvenilirliğin artmadığını söylüyor.

questions.prompt: Many sociologists maintain that rising income inequality weakens social trust, since people who feel left behind are less likely to believe that institutions act in their interest.
options: According to many sociologists, growing income inequality undermines trust in society, because those who feel excluded tend not to believe that institutions serve their interests.
Many sociologists argue that declining social trust is the main cause of rising income inequality, as institutions act against people's interests.
A few sociologists claim that rising income inequality strengthens social trust, since people who feel left behind rely more on institutions.
Many sociologists maintain that people who feel left behind are more likely to trust institutions, even when income inequality is rising.
Many sociologists maintain that rising income inequality may one day weaken social trust if institutions stop acting in people's interest.
questions.explanation_tr: 'Weakens' = 'undermines', 'left behind' = 'excluded', 'less likely to believe' = 'tend not to believe'; A anlamı korur. B neden-sonucu tersine çeviriyor, E ise bugünkü durumu gelecekteki bir olasılığa dönüştürüyor.

questions.prompt: The more fragmented a forest becomes, the harder it is for large mammals to find mates and food, which in turn increases their risk of local extinction.
options: The less fragmented a forest becomes, the harder it is for large mammals to survive, so their risk of local extinction rises.
Large mammals fragment forests while searching for mates and food, which increases the risk of local extinction for other species.
Forest fragmentation makes it harder for small mammals to find food, but it has no effect on the extinction risk of large mammals.
As forests become increasingly fragmented, large mammals find it more difficult to locate mates and food, and consequently face a greater risk of disappearing locally.
Even if a forest becomes highly fragmented, large mammals can easily find mates and food, so their risk of local extinction remains low.
questions.explanation_tr: 'The more ... the harder' orantısı D'de 'As ... increasingly ... more difficult' ile, 'in turn' ise 'consequently' ile verilmiş; A orantıyı 'less' ile tersine çeviriyor.

questions.prompt: Only when the underlying cause of chronic fatigue has been identified can doctors offer treatment that goes beyond simply relieving the patient's symptoms.
options: Even without identifying the underlying cause of chronic fatigue, doctors can offer treatment that goes beyond relieving the patient's symptoms.
Once doctors have relieved a patient's symptoms, the underlying cause of chronic fatigue usually disappears.
Doctors cannot provide treatment that does more than ease a patient's symptoms of chronic fatigue until they have determined its underlying cause.
Identifying the underlying cause of chronic fatigue is unnecessary, since relieving the patient's symptoms is the only treatment doctors can offer.
Doctors may identify the underlying cause of chronic fatigue, but they will never be able to relieve the patient's symptoms.
questions.explanation_tr: 'Only when ... can' yapısı, nedeni bulmanın ön koşul olduğunu bildirir; C bunu 'cannot ... until' ile karşılar. A 'even without' diyerek bu koşulu ortadan kaldırıyor.

questions.prompt: While urban planners once prioritised the movement of cars, many now design streets that encourage walking and cycling, recognising the health and environmental benefits of such choices.
options: Urban planners have always designed streets that encourage walking and cycling, although they now recognise the benefits of car traffic.
Many urban planners still prioritise the movement of cars, since walking and cycling offer few health or environmental benefits.
Because walking and cycling have become more popular, urban planners will soon stop designing streets for cars altogether.
A few urban planners may in the future design streets that encourage walking and cycling, if they recognise the health benefits.
Whereas urban planners used to focus mainly on car traffic, many of them now create streets that promote walking and cycling because they acknowledge the health and environmental advantages.
questions.explanation_tr: 'Once' (eskiden) ile 'now' (şimdi) arasındaki değişim ve 'recognising' (farkında olarak) gerekçesi E'de korunmuş; A 'always', D gelecek zaman ve 'a few' ile anlamı değiştiriyor.

questions.prompt: Contrary to popular belief, lightning can strike the same place more than once; in fact, tall structures such as skyscrapers are hit dozens of times each year.
options: As most people believe, lightning never strikes the same place twice, which is why skyscrapers are rarely hit.
Although many people think otherwise, lightning may hit a single location repeatedly, and tall buildings like skyscrapers are actually struck many times annually.
Contrary to popular belief, lightning strikes skyscrapers only once a year, since tall structures protect the surrounding area.
Lightning can strike the same place more than once, but tall structures are no more likely to be hit than short ones.
Because skyscrapers are hit dozens of times each year, people mistakenly believe that lightning can strike the same place more than once.
questions.explanation_tr: 'Contrary to popular belief' B'de 'Although many people think otherwise', 'dozens of times each year' ise 'many times annually' ile karşılanmış; C sıklığı 'only once' yapıyor, E yaygın inancı tersine çeviriyor.

groups.passage:
When the great ice sheets of the last glacial period began to retreat roughly 20,000 years ago, they left behind more than scattered boulders and carved valleys. The sheer weight of the ice, which in places exceeded three kilometres in thickness, had pressed the Earth's crust down into the more fluid mantle beneath it. Once that load disappeared, the crust started to rise again, a process geologists call glacial isostatic adjustment. Remarkably, the process is still under way. Parts of the Gulf of Bothnia, between Sweden and Finland, are rising by nearly one centimetre a year, and harbours built there in the Middle Ages now sit well inland from the present shoreline.

The phenomenon is not merely a geological curiosity. Because the mantle flows slowly, regions that were once at the margins of the ice sheets are actually sinking as material moves back towards the formerly glaciated centres. Some coastal areas of the eastern United States, for example, are subsiding by one to two millimetres a year for this reason alone, which adds to the threat posed by rising seas. Engineers planning flood defences therefore need to know not only how fast the ocean is rising but also whether the land itself is moving up or down.

Measuring these movements has become far easier since networks of satellite positioning stations were established. Even so, researchers caution that models of the mantle's viscosity remain uncertain, and estimates of future uplift could vary considerably depending on the assumptions used. Some scientists also suspect that the rapid loss of ice in Greenland and Antarctica today may be triggering a new, faster round of rebound, although the evidence for this is still being debated.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, some coastal areas of the eastern United States ----.

have medieval harbours that now sit well inland from the shoreline
were once covered by ice more than three kilometres thick
are protected from rising seas by the upward movement of the crust
are rising by nearly one centimetre a year, like the Gulf of Bothnia
questions.explanation_tr: İkinci paragrafta, buz tabakalarının kenarındaki bölgelerin manto malzemesi eski buzul merkezlerine geri aktığı için battığı ve ABD'nin doğu kıyılarının bu yüzden yılda 1-2 mm alçaldığı belirtiliyor.

satellite positioning stations have removed all uncertainty about future uplift
glacial isostatic adjustment ended shortly after the ice sheets retreated
the Earth's mantle is a rigid layer that cannot flow
flood defence plans that consider only the rise of the sea may misjudge the real risk to a coast
questions.explanation_tr: İkinci paragrafın sonunda mühendislerin yalnızca deniz seviyesini değil karanın yükselip alçaldığını da bilmesi gerektiği söyleniyor; buradan yalnızca deniz yükselişine bakan planların riski yanlış değerlendirebileceği çıkarılır.

groups.passage:

The idea became one of the most cited in the social sciences, but for decades it was difficult to test on a large scale, since most evidence came from surveys in which people recalled how they had found work. The growth of online professional networks offered a new opportunity. In a study published in 2022, researchers analysed experiments carried out on millions of users of one such platform, whose recommendation system had varied the kinds of contacts suggested to them. They found that moderately weak ties, rather than either the strongest or the very weakest, were most strongly associated with users later changing jobs.

The researchers also observed that the advantage of weak ties was greater in digital and technology-related industries than in sectors where work depends less on rapidly changing information. Some commentators raised ethical questions, noting that users had not been specifically informed that the suggestions they received were part of an experiment. Nonetheless, the findings broadly supported the original insight while suggesting that the relationship between tie strength and opportunity is more complex than a simple contrast between strong and weak.
